pending_carry_forward.reason: A refresh triggered from page.tsx's Server Component render cannot persist its new token pair -- Next.js seals the cookie jar there (RequestCookiesAdapter.seal). tokenStore tolerates it, so the render completes with a valid token, but the rotated pair is dropped. Harmless with Keycloak's default Revoke Refresh Token = OFF; with it ON, sessions end early. Durable fix: move refresh off the Server Component path (middleware, or a dedicated refresh Route Handler page.tsx bounces through).
